<!-- pr-reviewer: 78f2f0a85501d6c32ce9fcfc8e7e83776c2b0524 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**, after the two hand checks below (this PR changes posted G-code and adds an editor UI; a local build and tests cannot stand in for either).

Reviewed at the high tier (posted-G-code change). Trial merge with `upstream/main`: already up to date, no conflicts.

**What looks good**
- Every dialect that reads the coolant ask now resolves `air` from the machine's `Air` / `Air blast` entry or refuses by name: fanuc, fanuc-lathe, haas, sinumerik, heidenhain, mazak, doosan-dnm, tormach-lathe (the same 2-line change each: `COOLANT_KINDS` gains `air`/`air-blast`, `coolantFor` maps `air`). `tormach-plasma` already refuses every ask but Off; the `tormach` mill post does not read the ask, so the engine's `coolantModes` refusal covers an Air op. No shipped post is missed (checked all 11 in `assets/posts/`).
- `carvera.cps` stops guessing ("first Flood, else first coded entry"). It now declares `coolantModes`, posts the op's ask, and refuses by name when the machine states no code for it (never M7 for a flood ask, never M8 for an air ask, never silently dry). `coolant`/`coolantAsk` are reset in `endPreamble`, so one section's ask does not leak into the next.
- `tormach.cps` flood law now matches the generic posts (an Air-only or Mist-only list refuses a flood op instead of posting M7); an unstated list stays silent, a stated codeless Flood stays the operator's own valve.
- `CoolantMode::machine_default` and `CreateOperation` (create.rs:106-111) make a new op on the shipped Carvera start on Air, so the default path posts M7/M9 and does not hit the new refusal.
- Machine draft: `add_coolant` refuses an empty code by name, `remove_coolant` validates its pointer and index (no panic path), `save()` now checks refusals like `save_as()`. No unwrap/expect/panic added in non-test code.
- Goldens: none moved (`tests/golden/` and `crates/ui/tests/snapshots/` untouched); `nc/carvera/two_tool_pocket.nc` stays byte-identical because the stream now asks `air` and still posts M7/M9. No CHANGELOG edit, no process files touched, no `build.rs`/scripts/`.github`/deps changes, so building was fine.
- Process: `Fixes #869`, `Changelog:` line, `feat(post)!:` subject with a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer in the commit, decision file `docs/decisions/869-coolant-air.md`, provenance comment updated in `coolant.rs`, follow-up #954 filed for the MCP tool.

**Local results (merged with main, RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache)**

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | green: post suites 19s, app suites 37s (incl. `coolant_air`, `carvera_post`, `coolant_followups`, `machine_edit`), ui suites (lib incl. `machines_edit`) 40s |
| Extra app suites touching coolant / posts / machines (every `crates/app/tests/*.rs` mentioning coolant, 53 binaries, e.g. `coolant`, `fanuc_post`, `doosan_dnm_post`, `lathe_post*`, `posting`, `tormach_*`, `carvera_machines`, `project_roundtrip`, `machine_library`, drilling/probe/mill2d) | all pass, 0 failed (`center_cut_multiaxis` is a slow binary and was skipped) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None blocking.

**Needs a human before this ships**
1. Hub run: posted G-code changes on the Carvera and the generic posts. Please run an Air op and a default op on the Carvera, and a Flood + Air op on one generic post, through the Hub simulator, and confirm M7/M8 and the named refusals.
2. Hand check of the machine file editor (Add coolant with name + code, "Remove <coolant>" incl. the seeded Flood, Save / Save As blocked while a coolant is codeless). The one UI test drives the real shell, but layout is a visual matter.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Breaking change is correctly declared: a Flood op saved on an Air-only Carvera (and a generic-post machine whose only coolant is named "Air") is now refused by name where it used to post M7. Under 0.x this bumps MINOR; the release notes should say "breaking" first.
- `CoolantMode::Air` serialises as `"air"` in project files: an older build opening such a project will not read that op's coolant. Forward-only, consistent with a 0.x minor; no migration is needed since existing files stay valid.
- The mounted-machine editor in the Setup pane still adds a codeless Flood row (called out in the PR as not exercised; it never writes a file).
- The gate map does not pick the post-script suites for a `.cps` change; the author's and my extra runs covered that, but a map entry for `assets/posts/*.cps` would make quick catch it by itself.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
